content2.content: Apps need to respond to network changes in real-time. For example, pausing a download when the user goes offline or syncing data when they come back online.

content4.content: The `connectivity_plus` package exposes a stream `onConnectivityChanged` that emits updates whenever the connection status changes.

content8.content: Listening to connectivity streams allows your app to be reactive and robust, handling network transitions gracefully.
